Compliance check before postingChecked against MASA: no scheduled condition named anywhere; no cure/treat/prevent claims; Aisyah refers to a doctor if breathing feels uncomfortable, no diagnosis. API bands are the DOE categories; vitamin C and water figures marked approximate. Google Business: Update post, no phone/URL/hashtags/caps/offers. Yeoh to confirm before posting: all 7 staff (Aaron, Jocelyn, Catherine, Lois, Renee, CY, Joyce) are happy to appear publicly as named cartoon characters.

Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Hazy day in Johor Bahru? Meet the Alpro Pharmacy KSL team and their simple haze-day habits. 🌫️ In Episode 3 of our Uncle Lim series, Uncle Lim's new kopitiam friend turns out to be our Pharmacist Aaron, who sends him to walk inside KSL City Mall instead of outdoors. At the pharmacy he meets the rest of the team, and each has one tip: - Sip water often through the day - Move your walk indoors when the air is thick - Add guava and papaya for vitamin C - Keep windows closed on heavy haze days - If breathing feels uncomfortable, see a doctor Walk in for a Minute Consult with our pharmacists, or ask about Dietitian and Nutrition Counselling. No appointment needed. Lot G-001, Ground Floor, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. Open daily, 10AM to 10PM.
